meta.title: Print with Zwe
meta.description: Print with Zwe — Estimate MakerWorld and other 3D models, then message us for custom printing in Yangon.

brand.name: Print with Zwe
brand.tagline: Bringing your ideas to life, layer by layer.

hero.description: Find a model on MakerWorld or similar sites, estimate the print price here, then message us for custom printing or a visit.

find.title: Find a free model
find.body: Pick a free 3D model from MakerWorld, Printables, or Thingiverse.

measure.title: Check weight and time
measure.body: Open the model in a slicer like Bambu Studio or OrcaSlicer. Note the filament weight (grams) and print time (hours).
measure.hint: Weight and time show up in the slicer preview.

estimate.title: Calculate here
estimate.body: Enter the material, grams, and hours in the estimator below for a rough price.

contact.title: Message us for custom work
contact.body: For custom prints, material choices, or a shop visit, message us on Telegram.

calculator.title: Instant Price Estimator
calculator.description: Enter the material, weight, and print time from your slicer (MakerWorld models work the same way). Final price may vary with supports, infill, and complexity.
calculator.hint: Use weight and hours from your slicer. Pick one material and 1–4 colors (AMS). Mixing different materials needs a custom quote.
calculator.emptyStateHint: Enter weight or print time above to calculate a rough price.

shop.title: Shop Catalog
shop.description: Ready-to-order 3D prints with clear pricing. Message us on Telegram or call to place an order.
shop.emptyHint: Check back soon — new prints will appear here.
shop.errorHint: Please try again shortly, or contact us directly.
shop.soldOutHint: This item is currently sold out. Contact us — we can let you know when it's available again or suggest something similar.

contact.title: Get in touch
contact.subtitle: Reach us by phone, Telegram, Facebook, TikTok, or visit the shop — use whichever channel works for you.
